system.description: Seeing you use your weapon in combat (or perform showy moves outside of combat) gives one ally confidence that equates to a free level of Effort they can use on an action of their choice before their (or your) next ten-minute or longer recovery. Conversely, one foe can be cowed by this display, giving you a free level of Effort on a subsequent intimidation task. Enabler; action if used outside of combat.
